{{SameName|Hidden|[[Hidden (Attribute)|Attribute]] • [[Hidden|Enemy]]}} {{For|the [[Hidden Boss]]|[[Hidden Zoomer]]}} {{AttributeInfobox |title1 = Hidden |image1 = HiddenDetection.png |type = Enemy Type |detection = Hidden Detection |effects = Translucent Body |sandbox = Yes |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|HiddenDetection.png|Hidden}} }} ==Description== '''Hidden''' is an enemy type that makes the enemy require hidden detection to be targeted. ==Mechanics== Enemies that are '''Hidden''' cannot be detected by towers that do not have hidden detection. They may be indirectly damaged by towers that do not have hidden detection by collision with [[units]] or by being caught in an explosive radius, for example. The appearance of '''Hidden''' enemies are also affected, in which they will have a transparency.
